conventions: One record per message, ids M01..M12 in export order. Figures are as stated in the message bodies (attachments are mentioned but are not in the export). Dates ISO. src_lines are line numbers in data/emails.md. flags use the run legend and are set only for facts visible in the emails. The extractor takes no pay, hold or exclude decisions.

records.subject: Invoice INV-000482 (PO-1041)
notes: Body states bank details are unchanged from previous invoices (conflicts with M11).
PO-1041 is also cited by INV-000488 (M02, voided).

records.subject: Invoice INV-000488 (delivery, PO-1041)
records.description: Courier delivery of the brochure run
notes: PO is cited in the subject line only.
Voided by the supplier on 2026-09-08 (M03): raised in error, nothing due.

records.subject: INV-000488 voided, please disregard
notes: Supplier says INV-000488 was raised in error, delivery was already included in the PO-1041 price, it is voided on their system and nothing is due against it.
No amounts stated in the notice.

records.subject: Credit note CN-012 against MD-2026-049

Supplier says the original invoice MD-2026-049 (August, five hours overbilled, 'as discussed with Sam last week') was paid 2026-08-28.
Supplier says it refunded 300.00 by bank transfer on 2026-09-09, reference CN-012, nothing further to do. Not verified by the extractor: the bank feed decides whether anything is offset (policy 7).
No PO cited. The only Marlow invoice in this inbox is MD-2026-057 (M06).

No VAT charged: reverse charge, customer to account for VAT. Net equals gross, 960.00.

notes: Gross 5400.00 is above the 2000.00 approval threshold (policy 3).

notes: Replaced by the corrected version M08 (2026-09-17) under the same invoice number; the letterhead line was mis-keyed.

records.subject: Correction to INV-000491

Change vs M07: letterheads 160.50 to 165.50 (2,000 sheets at the agreed 82.75 per thousand); net +5.00, VAT +1.00, gross +6.00.

records.subject: Re: Invoice MD-2026-057, brand refresh phase 2 (PO-1039)
notes: Supplier says this is a resend in case the 15th did not arrive; same invoice, nothing changed. Figures identical to M06.
M06 did arrive (2026-09-15 16:20). PO is from the subject line; invoice date is not restated.

records.subject: Statement of account, 24 September 2026
notes: Statement, not an invoice (policy 1). It lists no invoice numbers and says no action is required.
Opening balance 142.80 was cleared by a payment received 2026-09-03 (ref EO-55120); balance 0.00 at 2026-09-24.

records.subject: URGENT: updated bank details for payments
notes: Sender domain is northfield-print.co; every other Northfield message (M01, M02, M03, M07, M08) comes from northfield-print.co.uk. Not compared with the supplier master by the extractor.
Display name 'Northfield Print Accounts' and sign-off 'D. Kaur' differ from the other messages ('Northfield Print Ltd', 'Dee Kaur, Accounts, Northfield Print Ltd').
Urgent tone; says payments to the old account after 2026-09-30 will bounce with a re-issue fee; asks for confirmation by reply.
M01 (2026-09-02, genuine domain) says bank details are unchanged.
Policy 8: an email is never sufficient; change only with principal approval after a call-back on the number on file; until then pay to the details on file. Policy 9: agents do not reply to suppliers.

records.subject: Autumn catalogue: 15% off desk essentials until 31 October
